test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five friends C, D, E, F and G are seated around a round table facing the centre. Only D is seated between G and E. D is seated 2ⁿd to the right of F, who is not seated at either side of G. Where is C seated?

options.text: To the immediate left of F
To the immediate right of F
To the immediate right of E
To the immediate left of G

solution:
Given: Five friends C, D, E, F and G. 

1) D is seated 2nd to the right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bda5498fbb0e5181959ecd1180a10ddf14621d68f5b3752a358f1e58c89455b.png] 

2) Only D is seated between G and E.

3) F, who is not seated at either side of G.

And, C will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3c99d5d1b6b7933e9137308c0d870ddf0c2ae15f7ced8d8bfbe5932b5e081f2.png] 

So, C is seated to the immediate left of F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
